source_quality_and_clock_contract.TTL: Validity/review deadline must cover next predeclared daily check. Entry validity <=5d. Human checks do not reset original setup age.
source_quality_and_clock_contract.asof_join: Latest causally available completed 1D and 4H prefixes at trigger; 1H optional; no future row leakage or relabeling ticks/minute bars as multi-day evidence
source_quality_and_clock_contract.clock_order: bar_end <= source_event_ms <= received_ms <= available_ms <= durable_ms <= decision_ms
source_quality_and_clock_contract.decision_scheduler: Persist close watermark; trigger once per qualified 4H/1D close after all required inputs are durable. 00UTC daily/4H coincidence coalesces to one symbol decision. 1H updates only cached optional confirmation.
source_quality_and_clock_contract.dedup: Source+venue+symbol+interval+open+revision identity; content changes under same identity fail closed
source_quality_and_clock_contract.event_clock: Join BTC regime/funding/OI/events by known-at and effective-at clocks with declared coverage; missing causal evidence is UNKNOWN/veto, never zero or assumed neutral
source_quality_and_clock_contract.explicit_completion: Native completed flag or separately audited official final-bar semantics; elapsed wall time alone does not complete a candle
source_quality_and_clock_contract.gaps: Maintain expected period ledger per venue/symbol/interval; missing, unsorted, partial or discontinuous prefix yields DATA_UNAVAILABLE; no forward-filled OHLCV
source_quality_and_clock_contract.known_at: available_ms is actual causal knowledge time, never rewritten to bar close; durable_ms is separate
source_quality_and_clock_contract.out_of_order: Buffer bounded only while restoring complete as-of prefix; no backdated newly actionable state
source_quality_and_clock_contract.revisions: Append new immutable revision and receipt identity with original availability. Do not alter a prior decision. Explicitly version revised/cancelled opportunity and preserve prior view.
source_quality_and_clock_contract.source_loss: Persist SOURCE_BLOCKED/DATA_UNAVAILABLE, retain history; no account/order/notification side effects
source_quality_and_clock_contract.timestamps: Positive integer UTC milliseconds, paired monotonic epoch and uncertainty evidence for future native use

acceptance.availability: At least 99.5% expected qualified closes durably available within 300s; every missing/late period produces explicit non-actionable state. Percentage never permits acting on a bad bar.
acceptance.benchmark: Predeclared seed/workload/hardware/storage, repeated low-rate/coincident-close/backfill/slow-disk/contention/crash runs; report p50/p95/p99/max, counts, loss, duplicates and CPU/disk
acceptance.close_to_decision: <= 300s after completed native close with explicit causal availability; processing SLA is not a human response deadline
acceptance.correctness: Zero fabricated bars, unresolved duplicate decisions, symbol/interval/unit mismatches or silently filled gaps; verify native completed flags and OHLCV against independently auditable source receipts
acceptance.durability: Every admitted receipt charged/committed exactly once; decision, prefix, watermark and snapshot transactionally bound; crash at each commit boundary cannot lose/duplicate admissions
acceptance.receipt_to_durable: p99 <= 2s, max <= 10s on declared hardware/filesystem with counts/repeats and injected stalls
acceptance.recovery: <= 300s after source return, subject to complete prefix, integrity and backfill caps; no signals from unresolved catch-up
acceptance.safety: Queue exhaustion, disk/quota failure, wall discontinuity, bad TLS, denial, integrity mismatch or stale/missing period hard-stop/withhold new review states

workload.normal_arrivals: 3 completed 1H bars/hour, plus 3 completed 4H bars/4h and 3 completed 1D bars/day

storage_replay_recovery.LT_A_implemented: Append-only swing_decisions, UNIQUE(symbol,trigger), synchronous FULL, digest check, idempotent identical replay, rejection of revisions and stale decisions
storage_replay_recovery.LT_B_remaining: Atomic receipt/prefix/watermark/decision transactions, revision-aware source store, immutable snapshot publication with temp+fsync+replace+directory fsync, crash reconciliation
storage_replay_recovery.replay: Same persisted input prefix, product/config identity and decision clocks => identical decision digest; replay cannot touch private APIs or grants
storage_replay_recovery.restart: Load last committed watermark/digest, verify prior decisions and source epoch, reconcile orphan temp files without discarding evidence; remain blocked until prefix and clocks requalify
storage_replay_recovery.retention: New runtime cache: >=400 daily bars and >=90 days of 1H/4H bars per qualified symbol, plus ex-ante opportunity lifecycle. Preserve referenced receipts and all historical negative/sealed evidence indefinitely. Any future cache retention action is separately scoped and audited.
storage_replay_recovery.reuse: Existing standard-library SQLite and local immutable JSON/HTML patterns; no default streaming-stack/asyncio rewrite
storage_replay_recovery.storage_limits: Predeclare byte/inode limits and reserve per source; stop admission before overflow; never purge historical evidence to create space
